name: Wrap Lines
description: Breaks the text into lines of a set width.
legacyScript: function animate(env,el,p){ var w=Math.round(p.width), words=el.text.split(/\s+/), lines=[], cur=""; for(var i=0;i<words.length;i++){ if(!words[i]) continue; if((cur+" "+words[i]).trim().length>w && cur){ lines.push(cur); cur=words[i]; } else { cur=(cur?cur+" ":"")+words[i]; } } if(cur) lines.push(cur); el.text=lines.join("\n"); return el; }
